brand_story.name: MANTRA (Mantra Golf)

founders.name: Dominic "Dom" Natalizio
founders.background: Former business/strategy consultant; part of the Conscious Capitalism movement; then worked at Lyft, where the polo idea formed (wore an athletic polo to the office and again at weekends). Developed the first product in LA. Self-described big adventurer/traveller. Was the primary full-time employee in the early years.

founders.name: Ashley Revay
founders.background: Grew up a golfer, played on her high school boys golf team; found women's golf apparel overlooked and unflattering. Designed the women's line launched in 2025. Early on contributed part-time (Natalizio calls her "my partner and co-founder Ashley"); was the media contact on the 2019 launch release.

brand_story.founded: 2019 (Crunchbase: September 2019; launch press release 18 Sep 2019; Catalyst Mantra Collar collection page created June 2019)
brand_story.based: San Francisco, California (Impact Fund address: 548 Market St, San Francisco)
brand_story.why: Dom's golf polo didn't look good off the course; Ashley found women's golf apparel overlooked/unflattering. Mission: "connect people to nature through golf"; design for a lifestyle on and off the course; "golf for the adventurous".
brand_story.ownership: Founder-led and independent as far as public sources show; no acquisition or major outside owner found (Natalizio mentions mentors and investors only generically). Not verified via filings.
brand_story.name_meaning: Story page: "Mantra define and guide us... We become our mantra." Tagline "Stand for Something" (printed inside hat linings). Natalizio ties it to the outdoors maxim "leave it better than you found it... It's a mantra that resonates with me."
brand_story.mantra_collar: The signature collar on the Catalyst Polo: a band/"blade" stand-up collar with a short button placket and no fold-down points, giving a cleaner off-course look (product photos confirm). Called "the product that started it all" (2019). PGA of America (29 Jul 2025) describes it as the "trademarked Mantra collar". A point-collar Catalyst was added in 2023. Paired with the MANTRA LOOP (trademark) shades holder at the placket. Patent claims seen only in an agency case study - unverified.
brand_story.logo_icon: Blue-Footed Booby ("BFB") icon used on sleeves, ball markers, hats.
materials_manufacturing: Catalyst Polo: custom knit 89% recycled polyester / 11% spandex, UPF 50+; sewn in a WRAP Gold-certified factory in Vietnam (current product pages).
2019 launch: polos made from 7-10 recycled plastic bottles each and described as "made entirely in the USA" (press release) - production has since moved to Vietnam (flag).
Signature tee/mock: 100% Peruvian Pima cotton interlock.
Essential layers: 58% Peruvian Pima / 39% eucalyptus Tencel / 3% spandex French terry.
Crossover trouser/short: 55% cotton / 34% recycled nylon / 11% spandex.
Heritage/Sonoran pique: 57% cotton / 38% modal / 5% spandex (Heritage spec).
Legacy fleece (new FW26): 85% cotton / 15% polyester heavyweight fleece.

Bluesign-certified dye methods; Climate Neutral certified (measures and offsets entire footprint); at least 1% of sales to conservation via the Mantra Impact Fund (grew out of an original 1% for the Planet commitment).
milestones: 2019: launch with the Mantra Collar polo ($88), six nature-inspired prints, each tied to a nonprofit (e.g. The Palm polo supporting Rainforest Alliance); online-only.
2023: Point-collar and long-sleeve Catalysts added; collections now inspired by "the most adventurous golf courses on the planet" - first trip Iceland, golf under the midnight sun (Story page).

Apr 2024: Masters Special Edition - "MANTRA Golf Club - Fruitland Nurseries Edition" graphic tees (green and cream), made in USA, celebrating the nursery that preceded Augusta National. Not licensed Masters merchandise.
Jun 2024: Namibia collection shot in the Namib Sand Sea dunes; $10,000 to Cheetah Conservation Fund's Livestock Guard Dog Program.
Sep 2024: Scottish Highlands Collection (tartans, Fescue, Sticks, Oak; Old Course shot-by-shot graphic tee).
Oct 2024: Norwegian Fjords Collection (Fjord Blue, Rockface, Tundra, Cascade, Shrub, Sea Ice).
Feb-Mar 2025: Baja Collection (Mexico shoot; Impact Fund coastal conservation project in Mexico). Mar 2025: Signature Tee/Mock Neck and Crossover trouser/short introduced.
Jun 2025: Mantra Women launched (designed by Ashley Revay); Swiss Alps Collection.
Jul 2025: walked the PGA Buying Summit Fashion Show (Frisco, TX).
Sep 2025: Redwoods Collection (FW25; Woods, Birch, Fig, Pine Needle, Raindrop).
Mar 2026: New Zealand Collection (SP26) and Georgia Pines Collection (Masters-week; limited "Georgia Pines" back-graphic tee "inspired by the greatest week in golf").
May 2026: Heritage Collection - relaxed cotton pique polos and mock necks "inspired by tradition".
8-9 Oct 2026: Sonoran Desert Collection (FW26) - first heavyweight fleece (Legacy Crewneck and Quarter Zip).
brand_story.pro_wearers: None found. No tour sponsorships verified.
brand_story.retail_partners: Press releases cite "select retail locations"; no named stockists found. Wholesale page exists (pages/wholesale-old) but is empty.
brand_story.catalyst_reviews: Catalyst Mantra Collar product page: 4.8/5 from 3,780 reviews, 96% would recommend (on-site reviews widget, 9 Oct 2026).

quotes.speaker: Dominic Natalizio (co-founder & CEO)
quotes.quote: I wore an athletic polo to the office and would usually turn around and wear that same polo on the weekend. I always wanted to dress up better for the office or drinks. But you know, I wanted to be comfortable first. That’s where the product idea started percolating.
quotes.source: Dom Natalizo – consultant turned carbon-neutral fashion founder (Q&A)
quotes.date: undated (content references Black Friday and Zoom calls; likely c. 2021-2023)

quotes.speaker: Dominic Natalizio
quotes.quote: There’s a saying in the outdoors community to “leave it better than you found it.” It’s a mantra that resonates with me, and simply put, this is our mission at MANTRA.
quotes.source: Dom Natalizo – consultant turned carbon-neutral fashion founder (Q&A)

quotes.speaker: Dominic Natalizio
quotes.quote: Our flagship product is the polo, and we call it the most versatile polo on the planet. You can wear it on a Zoom call, you can wear it when you're golfing, or you can wear it out on the weekend.
quotes.source: Dom Natalizo – consultant turned carbon-neutral fashion founder (Q&A)

quotes.speaker: Dominic Natalizio, Founder and CEO
quotes.quote: By combining the comfort and utility of stretchy performance fabrics with designer style, we've created the perfect gear for the city, outdoors, and everywhere in-between. Work, golf, tennis, biking, travel, happy hour … our polos are good for it all
quotes.source: MANTRA Launches New Category of Apparel Dubbed EverywhereWear - Versatile Gear for the Conscious Consumer

quotes.speaker: Dominic Natalizio, Founder and CEO
quotes.quote: We wanted to create a collection that not only honors the roots of golf but also connects our community to the incredible landscapes of the Scottish Highlands. Every piece in this collection is designed to evoke the spirit of Scotland, while also providing the modern golfer with the performance and style they expect from MANTRA.
quotes.source: MANTRA Launches the Scottish Highlands Collection: A Tribute to Golf's Birthplace

quotes.speaker: Ashley Revay, Co-Founder and Creative Director
quotes.quote: We wanted to create something that has never been seen before in the golf world, and [Namibia's] unique landscape offered the perfect canvas to bring this vision to life. ... Practicing our bunker shots in the world's oldest dunes was pure magic.
quotes.source: Golf Brand MANTRA Takes to Namibian Sand Dunes to Unveil Groundbreaking New Collection
quotes.note: Release text reads 'and Namibia's unique landscape' (country name is a hyperlinked word in the release); ellipsis marks an omitted middle sentence.

quotes_backup.speaker: Dominic Natalizio
quotes_backup.quote: Since the beginning, MANTRA's purpose has been to use our apparel to connect people to nature. This new collection takes that concept to the next level.

quotes_backup.speaker: Brand (Story page, unattributed)
quotes_backup.quote: Mantra define and guide us. They capture our intentions. Remind us of what we're striving to be today, guide us to what we're seeking to be tomorrow. We become our mantra.
